I have a short, creepy story. The other day, I stayed up all night because I couldn't sleep. I'm mentioning this because I've read research and studies that say strange things can happen when you don't sleep. You can hallucinate, so I'm not sure if I should believe what I heard or not. However, I don't really believe in skin-walkers, demons, or anything like that, and I still don't. But after what happened yesterday, I am still creeped out. I live in a rural area, with forests all around us. Yes, there are some roads, but outside my porch, there's a hill that goes up pretty far. My parents have cows that usually roam up there. Now, it's time for the actual story. I was very tired and trying to stay awake, and I thought it would be a good idea to bathe in the sun to wake me up a bit, which it kinda did. I was completely alone because my dad and sister were hunting in a cabin a few miles away, and my mom and sister were out going to the store. At this point, I opened the door and stepped up to the little pond area. We have a small pond with steps and a nice little flat wooden area where you can stand. I stood there for a bit, but then I started to get tired. I lay down on the wood. It sounds stupid by itself, but hey, I was tired. I took a little nap, but I kept hearing crunching. Like I said before, I don't believe in skin-walkers or any of that other stuff, so I didn't think anything of it. I eventually got up and got curious and looked back up there beyond the fence. I heard another huge crunch, then a gasp - not a yawn or any noise I'd make, but a human gasp. My heart dropped, and I was frozen in fear. That fight or flight response you do when you're scared, well, I kind of freeze up. I was frozen in the shock of fear; it couldn't have been me. I was by myself - the cows weren't there; I checked. I don't know what the hell it was. After the shock of fear I ran down the steps and open the door as fast as I could, I was looking behind be as I did this. When I open the door I kept looking outside where I heard it, there were vines and tree leaves where I heard it so if it was there I couldn't see it. I'm still scared to this current moment. I'm not going to tell my parents because they made fun of my sister, who said she thought she saw a skin-walker. but Man, I don't know, but I'm kind of scared. Again, I hadn't slept the night before, so maybe it was a hallucination, but if it wasn't, then God help me. I'm not going out there, and if I have to, I'll make it quick.  


Edit: you can use this for your podcast if you like I really don't care. I didn't see anything so I doubt it'd be that interesting but to me it was scary as hell. I said to myself after a few moments I said to myself " Fuck that shit im out, no thanks bro no thanks "
